Salted oat cookies

Ingredients

Makes 20

1

cup plus 2 Tbsp. (140 g) all-purpose flour

1

cup (90 g) rolled oats

1

tsp. (5 g) fine sea salt

½

tsp. baking soda

½

cup (1 stick; 113 g) unsalted butter, softened

¾

cup (150 g) dark brown sugar

1

large egg

1

tsp. vanilla extract

4

oz. (115 g) dark chocolate, chopped

Need a swap? Any chopped nuts can stand in for the chocolate.

Preparation

  1. Step 1

    Heat the oven to 350°F and line two sheets with parchment.

  2. Step 2

    Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the egg and vanilla.

  3. Step 3

    Fold in the flour, oats, salt, baking soda and chocolate.

  4. Step 4

    Scoop onto the sheets and bake 11 to 13 minutes.
